rows.text: Create a normalised EBITDA view using the template
Request and review all supplier, customer, and contractor contracts
Customer matrix, including Document renewal, pricing, and exclusivity terms clearly
Request details of all intellectual property (IP) registrations (trademarks, copyrights, patents)
Confirm business ownership of all critical digital assets (websites, emails, social media)
Identify and document any licensing agreements, royalties, or IP sharing
Create or update an IP Register clearly listing assets, expiry, and ownership status
Identify and document confidentiality and non-compete agreements (staff/suppliers)
Document any trade secret protections or trade restriction clauses
Summarise goodwill assets (reputation, awards, client goodwill)

cells: Physical invoice of any large expenditure
Will you be holding onto related businesses that you will not be selling?
